georef_note: Anchor placed from the cemetery's published coordinates: lat 39.13670, lon -93.30580, from Find a Grave cemetery 31354 (Mount Saint Marys Cemetery, Shackleford, Saline County, Missouri), read 2026-09-04. No GNIS record for this cemetery could be retrieved, so the Find a Grave value was used. That published point is assumed to fall at the centre of the mapped area (the A-H blocks plus the newer east field), and the anchor - the northwest inside corner of the loop drive, i.e. the northwest corner of Section A - is offset from it by half the mapped extent north and west.
published_point_source: Find a Grave cemetery 31354, Mount Saint Marys Cemetery, Shackleford, Saline County, Missouri (https://www.findagrave.com/cemetery/31354/mount-saint-marys-cemetery), read 2026-09-04. A GNIS record for this cemetery could not be retrieved, so the Find a Grave value is the one used.

anchor.description: northwest inside corner of the loop drive = northwest corner of Section A

scale.formula: WGS84 local degree lengths at the anchor latitude; 1 ft = 0.3048 m

layout_assumptions.ah_block_rows: A/B, C/D, E/F, G/H north to south, each 100 ft deep
layout_assumptions.ah_east_block: right-aligned to the 225 ft east edge of the block row
layout_assumptions.newer_field: 15 columns I-W of 15 ft, 80 rows of 5 ft, north edge level with the north edge of Section A
layout_assumptions.column_widths: from the paper number grids (see sections.csv columns)
layout_assumptions.section_H_added_strip: lots 161-170, a 5 ft column on the west edge, assumed to occupy the northernmost 10 rows

accuracy: Approximate. Derived from the paper column widths and a single anchor placed from the cemetery's published coordinates, north-up. Absolute accuracy is on the order of 10 to 20 ft; internal spacing follows the paper maps. Replace with surveyed corners when available.
how_to_replace: A survey replaces lots.geojson wholesale: produce polygons keyed by lot_id, set properties.geometry_source to 'survey', and set lots.csv geometry_source to 'survey' for those lots. Nothing else in the tables depends on this file.
